raw:
The user is writing UI strings for an app in Traditional Chinese. The screen: a player app, when user opens a recorded screen/video content, it can't play because the file format is unsupported.

They need:
- s1: error message (one sentence)
- s2: button on the error screen
- s3: name of this feature section at the top of the screen

Output only a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, string values, no other text.

Let me think about appropriate Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) strings.

s1: Error message, one sentence. Something like:「檔案格式不支援，無法播放此內容。」or「此影片格式不支援，無法播放。」The context is "錄好的畫面內容" — recorded screen content/video. So maybe:「此影片格式不支援，無法播放。」

s2: Button on error screen. Common options:「確定」「知道了」「返回」「重試」. Since the file can't play, "確定" or "返回" makes sense. Maybe「返回」 to go back. Or「確定」. I'll go with「返回」or「確定」. Hmm, an error screen with a dismiss button — often「確定」or「知道了」. I'll pick「確定」. Actually「返回」 might be more useful to go back to the list. But either works. I'll use「確定」.

Wait, maybe「重試」isn't right because retrying won't fix unsupported format. So dismiss-type button:「確定」.

s3: The name of the feature area at the top of the screen. This is likely the section title — where this content lives. "錄好的畫面內容" — recorded video content. The top nav title could be「錄影內容」「播放器」「影片播放」or the feature name like「我的錄影」「錄放影」. Since it's a player app opening a recorded screen recording, the top feature area might be「影片播放」or「錄影播放」. Hmm.

The s3 is "畫面頂端這個功能區的名稱" — the name of this feature area at the top. Likely a nav bar title. For a player app showing recorded video content: could be「錄影檔播放」 or「影片庫」 or「播放器」. I think something like「錄影播放」fits: the feature of playing recordings. Or simply「播放器」.

Given ambiguity, I'll choose「錄影播放」 — it names the feature area for playing recorded videos. Alternatively「影片播放」. I'll go with「錄影播放」? Hmm, but "錄好的畫面內容" suggests screen recordings. Common naming:「錄影清單」「我的錄影」. The feature area name at top of the player screen... I'll use「影片播放」. Actually let me reconsider: the app is a 播放器 app. The screen shows a recorded video that failed to play. The top bar could be the player's title area, e.g.,「播放器」. But "功能區" suggests a feature module name, like a tab name. Could be「錄影」 or「媒體播放」.

I'll go with「影片播放」 as a neutral, clear name for the feature area.

Hmm, alternatives: 「錄影內容」. Let me just decide: s3 = 「影片播放」.

JSON output only:

{"s1": "此影片格式不支援，無法播放。", "s2": "確定", "s3": "影片播放"}{"s1": "此影片格式不支援，無法播放。", "s2": "確定", "s3": "影片播放"}
